label: model output
about: A two-sentence summary of the flight picture for 2026-11-12 11:00-11:59 UTC, written by an open-weight model (meta-llama/llama-4-maverick) through OpenRouter from the JSON in input, and published only because every number in it is one of the input's numbers and it is two sentences (check). Model output: not checked for meaning beyond that, and not ours. The data itself: snapshots/ and crosswind.json.
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No forecast or advice of ours. Your airline decides whether your flight runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.
attribution: Aircraft positions: adsb.lol (https://adsb.lol), community ADS-B data, licensed under the Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). Our snapshots are a derived database offered under the same licence.
text: In the hour to 12 November 2026 12:00 UTC, 62 distinct airline flights were seen near Lisbon and 3 near Funchal. At Lisbon's LPPT airport, the wind was 13 knots from 240 degrees at 11:30 UTC, and at Funchal's LPMA airport, it was 4 knots from 140 degrees.

model.via: OpenRouter, through tools/llm.mjs (one ledger line per call)
